facts.text: The user requested that an expert generate text prompts for an image AI model.
The user asked for 5 image prompts based on two provided prompts.

The first provided prompt describes a photo of a 20-year-old girl with an LED visor helmet in a profile pose, bust shot, high detail, studio lighting, black background, smoke, sharp focus, cyberpunk style, and an 85mm Sigma Art lens.

The second provided prompt describes a girl with longer hair, an identical picture, a smaller nose, a smaller mouth, a beautiful girl, soft skin, proportionate body parts, small shoulders, and big breasts.
